purpose: Use space more effectively and give practical information greater visual impact without replacing the room identity.
changes: Wider arrival panel and shared content area; smaller outer and nested padding.
Coverage totals presented as large semantic facts with the existing listed-place caveat.
Destination photographs paired with bold names and listing counts in compact horizontal cards.
Room canvas and doorway keep their original 2:1 geometry; the reduced mobile room saves 100px at phone widths.
Wide directory rows align identity and facility facts side by side; compact layouts stack naturally.
Larger room availability, location, access and opening-hours information, with uncertainty and source details retained.
preserved: All place records, source links, translations and country data
Existing room artwork, door behavior, theme switch and category views
Search, filters, maps, tabs, saved places and visitor tools
limitations: Existing explicit browser URL policy block remains; no alternative rendering workaround used. Layout reviewed in source and offline DOM, not rendered pixels.
deployment: Only the authorized a7mad7amdoun/aroomtopray-preview GitHub Pages site. Unrelated pending map work remains outside the release.
